Hotel & Restaurant
The Original Castle in Edinburgh
Melville Castle combines Scottish grandeur with many original touches. Stay a while and take time to explore some of the castle's curiosities. Each of the castle's 33 bedrooms and suites are unique many have four-poster beds and all have been dramatically revamped. Every corner of the castle has been restored to give a gentle nod to its regal background, which Mary Queen of Scots used to visit. From our striking reception to our eclectic Library Bar, opulence is never too far from your fingertips.
ROOMS & SUITES |
Melville is synonymous with escapism. Get lost in our enchanted grounds and search for Queen Mary's five oak trees, wake from deep slumbers and indulge in the finest cuisine in the quirkiest of spaces. You're about to embark on a traditional adventure you'll cherish for a lifetime. Where better to stay when visiting Edinburgh than in a castle?

Traditional Luxury
Bed down beneath the turrets for a deep slumber
Home to 33 luxury bedrooms and suites, Melville Castle is the perfect place to treat yourself to some well-deserved R&R refined relaxation.
Our ornate, dramatically styled bedrooms are complete with crisp bedlinen, fluffy towels and magical views of the grounds. Four-poster elegance or suite romance; whatever your chosen boudoir, luxury is guaranteed. Oh, and there's also lots of other beautiful features we know you'll love:
400-thread Egyptian cotton sheets.
Luxurious duvets, sumptuous pillows, excellent mattresses.
Fabulous en-suite bathrooms.
Well-stocked hospitality tray.
HD TV
Iron and ironing board.
Free Wi-Fi.
All stays booked direct include a complimentary Full Scottish Breakfast each morning of your stay. Start your day with warm hospitality and a delicious breakfast, including cooked and continental options featuring classic Scottish favourites, fruit juices and perfectly brewed coffee.
2 Bedroom Suite
The grandest of them all...
...for those 'going all out' trips or 'all for all' family retreats.
Perfect for family stays, our Two Bedroom Suite offers oodles of space for the entire family to enjoy a truly divine castle retreat. With a gorgeous four-poster bed in one room, a fabulous twin bed in the other, plus a large family bathroom and a private living room, you'll be spoilt for choice as to where to put your feet up and relax.
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
1 Bedroom Suite
For showstopping stays...
...glamorous in every way!
Put romance on the menu with this breathtaking suite in the castle's West Wing, featuring the best bathroom in the whole castle! Bed down beneath the turrets in this fairytale dreaming den for a stay to remember. With a giant copper tub for two, his & hers basins and a spacious rainfall shower, we're certain our suite will be the perfect match.
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
Junior Suite
Two levels of luxury...
...for double the 'suite'-ness!
We can promise you - this is anything but 'junior'.
Experience a peaceful slumber in the mezzanine-level bedroom with Juliette balcony. Featuring a private living area, grand sofas to sink into and a lounge, this is a true home from home where you can relax in right royal style.
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
4 Poster Bedroom
Promising to take your breath away...
...with four times the luxury!
Grand in stature and size, our classically romantic four poster rooms occupy some of the finest positions in the castle. With walls draped in characterful charm and rooms dressed to impress, our sumptuous four poster beds are the star of the show. Perfect for romantic breaks, perhaps even proposals - these rooms ooze passion and charm
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
Superior Bedroom
Superior in every way...
...because you deserve nothing less!
Our light-filled superior castle rooms are as sumptuous as they are spacious. Recently revamped, they have large HD TVs, divine double beds, space to work, super-soft bedding, and eccentric decor. With grand headboards, lavish cushions and charming dressing tables, every inch of our Superior Rooms have been designed to 'wow'.
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
Classic Bedroom
A touch cosier in size...
... but grand in design!
Attention to detail doesn't go a miss in any of our rooms, and our classics are no exception. With ornate wallcoverings adorning the walls and plush furnishings aplenty, these recently revamped dreaming dens are the perfect castle havens. The large double beds are dressed in dreamy soft bedding and the bathrooms feature powerful showers.
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
Single Bedroom
Four poster elegance, just for one...
...because solo stays shouldn't compromise style or comfort!
Unique in every way, there is only one single room at the castle. It has all the home comforts you'll need, and is furnished in our classic showstopping style. Although smaller in size, our four-poster single room boasts all the opulence and luxury of our other bedrooms, with simply room for one. This snug castle hideaway is perfect for short stays and business trips.
CHECK AVAILABILITY |
In the know
Included in your stay
All accommodation bookings made direct with Melville Castle either by phone or booking through our website include:
Full Scottish Breakfast with cooked and continental options*.
Wi-Fi.
Parking in our private car park.
Doggy treats.
* If you book via a third-party website such as Booking.com or Expedia, please check your tariff because breakfast may not be included. If this is the case, a Full Scottish Breakfast is available for 17.50 per person.
Planning your stay
Check-in: 15:00
Check-out: 11:00
You are very welcome to arrive early if you'd like to explore Edinburgh and the surrounding area. If you're hoping to relax within the hotel, can we tempt you to one of our much-loved Afternoon Teas? Settle into your new royal home while sipping on tea or Prosecco and indulging in a selection of our finest sweet and savoury treats.
We will take care of your bags until your room is ready. If your room is ready before 15:00, we'll let you know. Late check-outs may be arranged for a small fee of 20.00 per room, please email reception@melvillecastle.com to arrange.
Dining times:
Breakfast is served from 07:30 - 09:30 Monday to Friday and 08:00 - 10:00 on weekends and Bank Holidays.
Afternoon Tea is served from 14:00 - 17:00 daily (pre-booking is essential 48 hours in advance)

Dog-friendly Stays
Top of the pups
We love dogs!
Royal experiences for all is our mantra and of course this extends to our much loved pooches. Why not treat the pup-King or pup-Queen of your household to a special castle stay? A supplement of 20.00 per dog per night applies, but check out our offers for free stays for your pup.
Up to two well-behaved pups are welcome to stay with you in the following bedrooms:
Classic Double (or Twin room).
Superior Double (or Twin room).
Four Poster.
One Bedroom Suite.
Two Bedroom Suite.
Junior Suite.
When they arrive for their stay, your hound will receive:
A friendly welcome.
Comfy doggy bed for use during their stay. (beds are limited, please request when booking)
Some special treats.
A Hound Bag tote filled with useful accessories for your stay, including a tennis ball, poo bags, dog treats and a local walking map.
Please bring bowls, a doggy towel, food and Fido's favourite lead.
Dog-friendly bedrooms must be pre-booked. Please use the dropdown to add a dog to your online booking, or call us on 0131 654 0088 to request a dog-friendly room when you make your booking. Unfortunately, if you arrive having packed a pup without booking, we may not be able to accommodate you.
Doggy Afternoon Tea
Doggy Afternoon Tea is served daily from 12:00 17:00 in the Arniston Room or Peacock Ante Room. Spoil your four-legged friend with:
A tennis ball to take home.
Choice of Lily's Kitchen wet food.
Organic dog biscuits.
A puppichino.
13.00 per pup
Doggy Afternoon Tea must be booked in advance, and is best enjoyed alongside human Afternoon Tea(!) Please note, location of tea is subject to change.
To book, call 01316540088 or email reception@melvillecastle.com . Please let us know of any dietary requirements when booking.
